title: models/<source>/<model>.yaml
description: One modeled table: its dimensions, measures and joins.

model.description: Model name, unique within its source. Equals the file name.

source.description: Source the model belongs to. Equals the directory name.

table.description: Qualified physical table name as in the snapshot.

status.description: Whether the owner has signed off this model as a whole. Tools only write draft; sl approve sets approved.

approved_by.description: Who approved it. Required when status is approved.

approved_at.description: ISO date of approval, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when status is approved.

approved_hash.description: sha256: and 64 hex characters, written by sl approve: the hash of the item's semantic content when it was approved. sl validate errors when the item no longer matches it, and warns when an approved item has none (sl approve --stamp-hashes records it).

description.description: What one row is and anything a reader must know.

grain.description: One sentence naming what one row represents. Required when approved.

primary_key.description: Columns that identify a row. Required when approved.

tags.description: Tags that access rules read. pii and sensitive are protected: the model and all its fields are hidden from everyone but the roles that grant the tag in allow.tags. public records that the owner confirmed everyone may see it.

ignored_columns.description: Columns of the table left out on purpose; sl draft --new-columns and sl status skip them.

open_questions.description: Questions still open with the owner.

dimensions.description: Fields to group and filter by. Required; [] when the model has none.

measures.description: Aggregations over the table. Required; [] when the model has none.

joins.description: Joins to other models of the same source.

name.description: Dimension name. Shares one namespace with the model's measures and joins.

expr.description: SQL expression over this table's columns, and join references through this model's many_to_one or one_to_one joins: <join>.<column>, or <join>.<join>.<column> through a to-one join of the joined model. No other table, schema-qualified name or subquery.

time_grains.description: Grains a time dimension can be truncated to. Only on type time.

time_zone.description: Only on type time: the IANA zone (America/New_York, UTC) the dimension's values are stored in, for a timestamp without a time zone. A timestamp with a time zone carries its own. sl validate errors on a zone it does not know.

synonyms.description: Other words people use for it.

tags.description: Tags that access rules read. pii and sensitive are protected: the field is hidden from everyone but the roles that grant the tag in allow.tags. public records that the owner confirmed everyone may see it although it looks sensitive; it never overrides pii or sensitive.

status.description: Whether the owner has signed off this dimension. Tools only write draft; sl approve sets approved.

approved_by.description: Who approved it. Required when status is approved.

approved_at.description: ISO date of approval, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when status is approved.

approved_hash.description: sha256: and 64 hex characters, written by sl approve: the hash of the item's semantic content when it was approved. sl validate errors when the item no longer matches it, and warns when an approved item has none (sl approve --stamp-hashes records it).

name.description: Measure name. Shares one namespace with the model's dimensions and joins.

expr.description: SQL expression aggregated, over this table's columns only. Optional only for count, which then counts rows.

filter.description: Optional SQL predicate over this table's columns, and join references through this model's many_to_one or one_to_one joins: <join>.<column>, or <join>.<join>.<column> through a to-one join of the joined model. No other table, schema-qualified name or subquery.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, only with format currency. An approved measure with format currency and no currency gets a warning.

description.description: What the measure means. Required when approved.

synonyms.description: Other words people use for it.

tags.description: Tags that access rules read. pii and sensitive are protected: the field is hidden from everyone but the roles that grant the tag in allow.tags. public records that the owner confirmed everyone may see it although it looks sensitive; it never overrides pii or sensitive.

status.description: Whether the owner has signed off this measure. Tools only write draft; sl approve sets approved.

approved_by.description: Who approved it. Required when status is approved.

approved_at.description: ISO date of approval, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when status is approved.

approved_hash.description: sha256: and 64 hex characters, written by sl approve: the hash of the item's semantic content when it was approved. sl validate errors when the item no longer matches it, and warns when an approved item has none (sl approve --stamp-hashes records it).

join.description: A join to another model of the same source.

name.description: Join name. Shares one namespace with the model's dimensions and measures.

to.description: Target model, a bare name in the same source.

keys.description: Column pairs that must be equal.

to.description: Column of the target model's table.

relationship.description: Rows of this model per row of the target. one_to_many fans out.

origin.description: declared (a foreign key), inferred (naming) or owner (stated by the owner).

status.description: Whether the owner has signed off this join. Tools only write draft; sl approve sets approved.

approved_by.description: Who approved it. Required when status is approved.

approved_at.description: ISO date of approval, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when status is approved.

approved_hash.description: sha256: and 64 hex characters, written by sl approve: the hash of the item's semantic content when it was approved. sl validate errors when the item no longer matches it, and warns when an approved item has none (sl approve --stamp-hashes records it).

to.description: Target model the check measured. When it differs from the join's to, sl validate warns.

keys.description: Key pairs the check measured. When they differ from the join's keys, sl validate warns.

to.description: Column of the target model's table.

left_null_keys.description: Rows of this table with a null key.

matched_rows.description: Rows of this table with a match.

right_key_unique.description: Whether the target key is unique.

left_key_unique.description: Whether this table's key is unique.

max_fanout.description: Most target rows matching one row of this table.

suggested_relationship.description: Relationship the data supports. many_to_many needs a bridge table.

fanout_override.description: Why an approved many_to_one or one_to_one join stands although its evidence shows fan-out (the target key is not unique or a row matches more than one target row), such as a known-dirty key the owner accepts. Without it sl validate errors on such a join.
